text: The ballroom's impossible music continues without an audience. The ash trees mark the same paths as before, and the party can choose which part of the court to risk next.

views.text: The damp floor, ash roots, and dark service arches have not moved. A narrow door by the musicians leads toward the dining hall.
The polished dance floor gleams beneath the false stars. The musicians smile as if they remember the party, and every arch looks like a garden gate.
